coverage_note: A clear lesson with a focus on 'my favorite', 'types of', 'the first/last', and adjective agreement. English explanations from Amal are frequent and well-captured.

rows.medi_said: أنا راح أطلب، uh, إلها is it أط-- أطلب لها؟
rows.amal_said: You're gonna ask of her? You-- or you're gonna order for her?
rows.why: He used 'إلها' (to/for her) with 'أطلب' when he meant to ask/request FROM her ('منها').

rows.medi_said: Hold on. Less was it um, ألأ؟ شوي-- شوي ألأ شوب.
rows.why: He couldn't remember 'أقل' (less) and kept saying 'ألأ'. Amal supplied the correct word.

rows.medi_said: الكلمات الطبيعات.
rows.why: He made 'nature words' an adjective matching phrase ('الكلمات الطبيعات') instead of an idafa construction ('كلمات الطبيعة').

rows.medi_said: اممم. Just المفضل؟
rows.why: He asked if he could just say 'المفضل' to mean 'my favorite' standing alone; she added 'عندي' to support it.

rows.medi_said: بوظة حلوة المفضل عنـ عندي
rows.why: He dropped 'el-' on the subject noun 'بوظة' when making a general statement.

rows.medi_said: هدول الـ-- Is it مسلسلين؟
rows.why: He asked if the plural for shows was the dual form 'مسلسلين'; she corrected him with the plural 'مسلسلات'.

rows.medi_said: So الـ مف-- الـ مف-- No. My favorite. Yeah. الـ مفضل. No. مفضل الـ. الـ مفضل الـ.
rows.why: He tried to put 'مفضل' before the noun; she said no, and he realized it goes after as an adjective.

rows.medi_said: Um, the other lake. So بحيرة تاني.
rows.why: He omitted 'el-' on both words and used the masculine 'تاني' for the feminine 'بحيرة'.

rows.medi_said: هذه الـ شاطـ...
rows.why: He used feminine 'هذه' for 'شاطئ' which is masculine.

rows.medi_said: أول واحد...
rows.amal_said: It is so واحد أو واحدة.
rows.why: He used masculine 'واحد' for 'غابة' (forest). Amal prompted him to use the feminine.

rows.medi_said: So there's no الـ... Uh, no هذي الغابة. Okay. Ha-- uh, اللي...
rows.amal_said: No، you said أول غابة. So you don't need اللي.
rows.why: He tried to use 'اللي' after 'أول وحدة' which is an indefinite construction.

rows.medi_said: أنا بروح أو أنا بروحها.
rows.why: He attached the pronoun directly to the verb ('بروحها') instead of using the preposition 'على'.

rows.medi_said: هذا نفس المنظر I saw in Madrid. ش-- اه،
rows.chat: hada nafs el-manzar illi shufto fi Madrid
rows.why: He dropped 'اللي' when translating 'that I saw'.

rows.medi_said: Is it منظرات؟
rows.why: He tried to make a regular feminine plural out of 'منظر'; Amal told him it's a broken plural.

rows.medi_said: I brought you. أنا جبت، جبتك.
rows.why: He attached the pronoun directly to the verb 'جبتك' (I brought you [your body]) instead of 'جبت لك' (I brought FOR/TO you).

rows.medi_said: هذا غير الـ...
rows.why: He tried to put 'el-' directly after 'غير'.

rows.medi_said: So هذا غير أنواع
rows.why: He incorrectly used the plural 'أنواع' instead of 'نوع' after 'غير' for 'different type'.

rows.medi_said: Is it the same mukhtalif anwa? Mukhtalif nuwa?
rows.amal_said: لا، نوع مختلف. 'Cause مختلف is just an adjective. Can't be anything else.
rows.why: He asked if the adjective 'مختلف' goes before the noun; Amal corrected that it goes after.

rows.medi_said: أنا جربت أنواع أنواع مختلف الأكل.
rows.why: He failed to pluralize/make feminine the adjective 'مختلف' to match the plural 'أنواع'.

rows.medi_said: أنواع مختلفين الأكل.
rows.chat: min awal yoami, ana jarrabet anwaa3 mu5talefeen min el-akel
rows.why: He dropped the preposition 'من' linking types and food.

rows.medi_said: أعطيني ثلاث، ثلاث ورقة، ثلاث ورقة.
rows.why: He used a singular noun 'ورقة' after the number 3; Amal reminded him to add the plural ending.

rows.medi_said: أنا بحتاج uh, ورقة ورقة تانية or أنا بحتاج uh, غير الـ ورقة.
rows.amal_said: ال never غير، غير never ends.
rows.why: He added 'el-' after 'غير', which is never correct.

rows.medi_said: أنا بحتاج ورقة ورقة كمان.
rows.amal_said: If it means other, another, yes.
rows.why: He put 'كمان' after the noun when meaning 'another', but for that meaning it must precede the noun.

rows.medi_said: أغلب البيوت في أمريكي-- أمريكا عندهم.
rows.why: He used 'عندهم' (people have) for houses; Amal corrected to 'فيهم' (in them).

rows.medi_said: Is it حشاشيش؟ I forgot the plural.
rows.why: He invented a broken plural 'حشاشيش' for grass, which is a mass noun.

rows.medi_said: Would-- Is this من؟ Okay.
rows.why: He asked if 'أغلب' needs 'من' after it; she told him no, it just takes the definite noun.

rows.medi_said: آخر سؤالي
rows.amal_said: It has two ways to say it. My question that is, mm, that is the last one, which is سؤالي الأخير.
rows.why: He said 'آخر سؤالي' meaning 'the end of my question', not 'my last question'.

rows.medi_said: هذا لعبي الأول. Huh? أو...
rows.chat: haadi lu3beti el-oola / awal lu3be ili
rows.why: He used masculine demonstrative, noun and adjective ('هذا لعبي الأول') for game ('لعبة') which is feminine.

rows.medi_said: لـ، uh, لعبة، لعبة تانية. لعبة تانية؟
rows.why: He dropped 'el-' on both words when trying to say 'the other game'.

rows.medi_said: أكتر آآآ أكتر، uh... آآآ بتبسط.
rows.why: He put the degree adverb 'أكتر' before the verb instead of after it.

rows.medi_said: آآآ أغلب الـ لُعب، آآآ لُعب، لُعبا-- لُعبات؟
rows.why: He tried to apply a regular plural ending '-aat' instead of using the broken plural 'ألعاب'.

rows.medi_said: آخر لعبتي، no?
rows.chat: lu3beti el-a5eera / aa5er lu3be ili hoan el-yoam
rows.why: He said 'آخر لعبتي' which means 'the end of my games' instead of 'لعبتي الأخيرة'. He also struggled with the feminine adjective.

rows.medi_said: هادي آخر اللعبة إلي.
rows.amal_said: No, آخر اللعبة means end of.
rows.why: He included 'el-' after 'آخر', which changes the meaning to 'the end of the game'.

rows.medi_said: Yeah، آخر اللعبة، آآآ مـ... آآآ كـ... كانت بتزهق
rows.amal_said: كان and آخر. So كان بيزهى. 'Cause I'm talking about
rows.why: He made the verb feminine ('كانت') to match 'لعبة', but the true subject is the first word of the idafa, 'آخر' (the end), which is masculine.
rows.english: The end of the game was boring
